meta.title: Orbit IT School — online and offline IT career training
meta.description: IT career school: Frontend, Backend, Mobile, UI/UX, Data, AI, QA, DevOps and more. Hands-on practice, mentors and job placement help.

hero.title: Pick a profession.
hero.subtitle: 12 career paths, hands-on practice and mentors from the industry. Start from zero and land your first offer.

about.title: Everything you need to get into IT.
about.subtitle: Our training is built around outcomes: real projects, live mentors and support all the way to employment.

items.title: Practice from week one
items.text: 70% of the time is code and projects. You graduate with 4–6 portfolio pieces.

items.title: Mentors from the industry
items.text: Taught by developers and leads from real companies, not theorists.

items.title: Career support
items.text: CV, LinkedIn, mock interviews and direct referrals to partner companies.

items.title: Flexible format
items.text: Online, offline or hybrid — pick what fits your schedule. Lessons are recorded.

items.title: Community
items.text: Private chats, hackathons and alumni meetups — you are never on your own.

items.title: Always up to date
items.text: Programmes are refreshed every quarter alongside the market and technology.
